source: README.md, section Results. Every number below was measured by the script named next to it.

tiers.name: Planted faults
tiers.dataset: 1,000 faults injected into the Fisy model
tiers.reading: Almost never wrong when it speaks, but it stays quiet far too often.

tiers.name: Outside answer key
tiers.dataset: 70 ExceLint workbooks, 700 labelled bug cells, run untuned
tiers.reading: The honest number, and it is bad. dead_input alone produced 15,351 of the false positives.

tiers.name: Real AI generated workbooks
tiers.dataset: 498 Spreadsheet Arena workbooks, no labels exist
tiers.reading: A median of one finding per file. Still outstanding: a hand audit of 30 sampled workbooks, so there is no false positive estimate yet.

retrieval.caveat: A known passage test: the questions were written from passages already read, so it measures whether search works, not blind performance.
